# Dragon egg

Type: Misc | Internal ID: DragonEgg | Source: Nests in the, Mountain, biome | Usage: Summon, Moder | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): No

# Introduction

Dragon eggs are items found in Drake Nest in the Mountains. They are far heavier than they look, with a faint humming sound.

## Usage

A total of three Dragon eggs are required in order to summon the fourth boss Moder.

## Notes

• Like other raw metal materials, Dragon eggs cannot be teleported without a Portal stone.
• Normally protected by Drakes.
• Dragon eggs will respawn after 480 minutes (8 real-time hours).

Categorias: Misc Items, Can't be Teleported, Forsaken offerings
